purpose: Small reusable CSV support, unit dictionary and input/provenance JSON. Future code/numerics are a separate authorized packet; ledgers may travel in a data companion ZIP, not raw large textual PR diffs.

format.csv: UTF-8, comma separated, header row, 17 significant digits, dot decimal; no thousands separators
format.json: UTF-8; null allowed with explicit reason; reject NaN/Infinity
format.synthetic: Every result row is labeled synthetic=true; parameter source is illustrative assumption. No measured observations.
format.initial_row: time=0 states and cumulative gross/net amounts are included. No preceding increment exists, so step increments, h, endpoint energy and gap null with not_applicable_initial_step. Mathematical cumulative zeros are numeric 0.

unit_dictionary.G_ex: J Gibbs relative to declared equilibrium

files.row_scope: one row per declared core/auxiliary case, seven rows; no optional mechanism/case family
files.rule: Derived values use only declared independent settings. All units and liquid/equivalent basis are explicit; no inconsistent user-supplied overrides.

files.row_scope: default candidate and its half-step partner for the three core cases; all four auxiliary trajectories. Initial and every actual step included. Other refinement histories are summarized in verification records, with exact rerun inputs/code pins later.
files.rule: Direct two-state BE endpoints. Gross cumulative amounts are sums of independent V*h*k*c_new increments; xi is their difference. Keep state-derived extents separate residuals. Thermo status finite, zero_boundary or empty; At the initial B=0,A>0 boundary Q is numeric 0, DeltaG/P null; at A=0,B>0 Q/DeltaG/P null. Each null carries its reason. Activities retain valid numeric zeros. Powers at all nonempty positive-time rows finite.

files.row_scope: Long form per case, run, physical time, support ID and quantity: same 401 snapshots for each declared refinement; fixed candidate/half-step union; fixed last-three union for order. A reference row is paired at exactly that time. Duplicate physical times across distinct labeled supports are permitted, duplicate logical IDs are not.
files.rule: All three core cases; direct independent analytic reference; linearly interpolate only states and cumulative gross throughputs. Recompute xi from gross difference and G_ex from interpolated states; never interpolate nonlinear G_ex then relabel it as state free energy. Exact endpoints flag false. All half-step and order operands are reconstructible from the paired long-form rows; do not silently change support.

files.row_scope: One row per declared run/benchmark/metric/support. Includes actual failed and passing candidates, auxiliary metrics, orders, both normalizations and exact thresholds, not only the selected default.
files.rule: PASS/FAIL/UNRESOLVED only after future execution; planned records are not emitted as observed PASS. Orders for equilibrium/empty null. Criterion text preserves exact comparison, raw residual/minimum and roundoff. Exact zero-denominator metrics follow the benchmark null rules.

contents: input settings, implementation/reference/export hashes and executable command later
actual full step sizes, windows, endpoint arrays or precise generation specification and actual shortened steps
401 support and candidate/halfstep/last-three union generation identities
B01-B08 metrics/status/reasons and invalid-input rejection evidence
ordered candidate attempts, true failure reasons and proposed default, still pending independent EIC acceptance
arithmetic reconstruction readback from saved CSVs and its identities
limits: numerical verification only, no empirical calibration/validation/learner benefit
reaction basis and liquid unit dictionary
all symbols, column meanings, null handling and sample kinds
selected candidate is separately accepted or pending, never inferred from contract alone
reference and solver commands only after authorization; this proposal contains neither

no_python_reconstruction: In case-settings, derive n_A0=V*c_A0, n_B0=V*c_B0, N=n_A0+n_B0, tau=1/lambda and RT=R*T.

For each endpoint, delta_Xi_plus=V*actual_h*k_f*c_A_new and delta_Xi_minus=V*actual_h*k_r*c_B_new; cumulative sums form Xi_plus and Xi_minus. xi=Xi_plus-Xi_minus; check n_A=n_A0-xi, n_B=n_B0+xi independently.

For positive states, a_i=c_i/c_standard, Q=a_B/a_A, DeltaG=-R*T*LN(K_eq)+R*T*LN(Q), P=-V*r_net*DeltaG. For B=0,A>0 keep Q=0 but DeltaG/P null; for A=0,B>0 Q/DeltaG/P null; for empty all three null. Use IF branches for true zeros, not LN(epsilon).
G_ex=RT*V*SUM[c_i*LN(c_i/c_i_eq)-c_i+c_i_eq], replacing only the c_i*LN term by its continuous zero limit when c_i=0. For empty C=0, G_ex=D=0 with undefined Q/DeltaG/P.

Compute each state drop from preceding G_ex and endpoint_power_energy=actual_h*P_new; gap=drop-endpoint_power_energy. Summing state drops telescopes; use independent reference comparisons for accuracy.

Use comparison rows paired at identical support/time; differences and normalized max errors reproduce benchmark norms; orders use LN(E_h/E_h2)/LN(2) only above the declared floor. Relative-energy tail accuracy and continuous power-integral equality are not promised.
zero_and_precision_limit: Spreadsheet reconstruction thresholds include retained 17-digit source numbers and true zero branches. Stable log1p/expm1/series may be needed in future reference code close to equilibrium/time zero; exported quantities allow arithmetic interpretation without requiring students to implement these functions.
no_new_export_family: No full species network, ATP/growth tables, fit/optimizer, optional alternate-law data, extra worksheets or new learner tasks. Designer/EIC may reuse these defined fields within their later accepted teaching scope.
